title: Object Storage: outage review — remaining concession allocation
content:
For Object Storage outage review, subtract the magnitude of signed net amount on all posted service concession credits for the exact source charge; correction credits are excluded. Only provider fault incidents qualify; subtract previous service-credit magnitude from the total ceiling and floor the additional allocation at zero, otherwise the additional allocation is zero.

## Basis Q&A

What determines outage review in this situation? Subtract the magnitude of signed net amount on all posted service concession credits for the exact source charge; correction credits are excluded. Only provider fault incidents qualify; subtract previous service-credit magnitude from the total ceiling and floor the additional allocation at zero, otherwise the additional allocation is zero.

## Hypothetical outage review — remaining concession allocation case

For this outage review — remaining concession allocation example, assume a hypothetical total concession ceiling of USD 64 and previous exact-source service concession magnitude of USD 23. For provider fault, the remaining allocation is USD 41. If the previous magnitude were USD 70 instead, the remaining allocation would be zero.
